title: Authorization Grant Resource
description: Schema for returning consumable and persistent authorization grants.

validFrom.description: Start of the period in which the grant is valid.

validTo.description: End of the period in which the grant is valid. May be null, meaning the grant has no end date.

principal.description: The agent the authorization concerns. This is the requestedPrincipal agent of the source document or request.

grantedBy.description: The agent that gave the authorization. This is the requestedOf agent of the source document or request.

grantedTo.description: The agent that holds the authorization. This is the requestedBy agent of the source document or request.

approvedBy.description: The person who signed the source document or approved the source request.

source.description: The authorization document or request the grant was created from.

self.description: Link to this resource, relative to the API base URL.
